title: Gate State Resolution
description: Resolves the active GWC gate from intake facts, task artifacts, and prior gate evidence before any transition is considered.
intent: Resolve exactly one current typed GWC gate state from canonical intake, scope, evidence, transition, and prior-resolution inputs without inferring PASS, granting authority, or performing a transition.
outcome: Typed GateStateResolution with current_gate, gate_status, last_passed_gate, next_gate, next_action_class, canonical evidence references, missing/stale/conflicting evidence, drift decision, replay status, deterministic resolution_digest, and authority-negative flags.
constraints: The resolution must be a pure function of supplied inputs; it must not read or mutate external state.
Canonical evidence and fixed reason precedence control the result; task projections are warnings only and cannot grant authority.
Current base SHA, scope identity, evidence-map bindings, and exact G3-or-later head SHA must match; normal descendant drift is not itself a blocker when the current canonical base is bound.
Stale, contradictory, malformed, missing, or later-gate-inheritance evidence fails closed at the earliest affected gate.
Replay with the same idempotency key must return the same resolution_digest; a semantic mismatch must return GATE_STATE_REPLAY_CONFLICT.
The result never grants gate, write, PR, merge, deploy, release, production, credential, migration, or production-data authority.
exclusions: Mutating task, gate, repository, PR, Jira, deployment, release, or production state.
Performing a gate transition, approval, merge, deploy, release, migration, or production-data operation.
Using projection-only status as canonical authority or inheriting a later gate over an unresolved earlier gate.
Network access, credential or secret handling, destructive operations, and schema or policy migration.
entry_guards: canonical scope identity, evidence map, transition map, and prior-resolution inputs are available
node evidence ledger and runtime binding are present

reason_codes.GATE_STATE_INPUT_INVALID: Supplied task, repository, SHA, scope, evidence-map, transition-map, or event inputs are structurally invalid.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_REPLAY_CONFLICT: The same idempotency key produced a different semantic resolution; fail closed.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_BINDING_MISMATCH: Scope, evidence, prior-resolution, or exact-head bindings do not match.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Canonical evidence is contradictory or duplicated with conflicting values.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_GATE_FAILED: The earliest required gate has a terminal failure.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_DRIFT: The current base, evidence base, or bound head has drifted and requires revalidation or reapproval.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_LATER_GATE_INHERITANCE_REJECT: A later-gate result cannot inherit over an unresolved earlier gate.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_RESOLVED: The canonical gate state resolved without a blocking condition.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_PROJECTION_MISMATCH: A task projection disagrees with canonical state; projection remains non-authoritative.
reason_codes.GATE_STATE_G6_NOT_APPLICABLE: G6 is not applicable because production scope is not authorized.
